_comment: Static conference calendar — update annually. Dates are approximate until official announcements. abstract_url and materials_url should be updated once known.

conferences.name: AACR Annual Meeting 2026
conferences.notes: Abstracts published in Cancer Research supplement. Main in vivo CAR-T sessions typically in immunology and cell therapy tracks.

conferences.name: ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting 2026
conferences.organiser: American Society of Gene and Cell Therapy
conferences.notes: Primary conference for in vivo CAR-T. Abstracts go live April 27. Late-breaking abstracts presented at meeting.

conferences.name: ASCO Annual Meeting 2026
conferences.notes: Clinical data focus. Relevant for watchlist companies with Phase 1/2 data readouts. Abstracts in Journal of Clinical Oncology supplement.

conferences.name: EHA Annual Congress 2026
conferences.notes: Key European hematology meeting. Relevant for blood cancer indications pursued by watchlist companies.

conferences.name: ASH Annual Meeting 2026
conferences.notes: Most important hematology meeting of the year. Late-breaking abstracts often include major CAR-T clinical data. Abstracts in Blood supplement.

conferences.name: SITC Annual Meeting 2026
conferences.notes: Immunotherapy focus. Increasingly relevant as in vivo CAR-T moves toward clinical stage. Dates TBC.
